resources.string: Icons with labels and nothing else: no bar and no indicator. The selected tab is drawn in ink.
Launcher: every item is a shortcut
Tap an item. Nothing stays selected.
Open Inbox or Alerts to clear its badge.
A centred title, a way back and up to two actions. Scroll the text: a hairline appears once content lies under the bar.
Scroll the text, or tap a button in the bar.
The bar is as quiet as the page under it. It has no shadow and no colour of its own.
While the text rests at the top, nothing separates the bar from it. Once the first line has moved underneath, a hairline is drawn from edge to edge.
The title stays in the centre whatever buttons are present. Both sides give it the same room, so a lone back button never pushes it aside.
Scroll back to the top, or tap the back button, and the hairline is gone again.
Fill layout: every tab gets the same width. Tap a tab, swipe the page or tap a dot; the three stay together.
Everything that was stopped, newest first.
Messages kept out of the inbox.
Scroll layout: every tab is as wide as its label, and the row moves when they do not fit.
Drag the row sideways, then tap a tab.

Extracted from the original app: the navigation row in launcher mode, icons over labels with no bar behind them. New in Sancai: its tabs mode and badges, the top bar, the tabs, the pager and the page dots.
